overview: Arjun is a unique Brawler/Zoner with an emphasis on dealing gray life damage on block with all of his special attacks. Arjun's main appeal is his unique mechanic as already explained before, gray life (or recoverable life). This is a mechanic unique to Arjun, DI, & Drive Reversal but unlike these 2 universal options, Arjun actively uses it as a pressure tool in that if an opponent blocks too many special attacks, the next strike or throw will eliminate the gray health accumulated from blocking.

Arjun has a variety of decent normals, Standing HP comes to mind as it boasts gigantic range & a TC follow up that leaves Arjun right next to the opponent on hit & in the corner, can lead to a super cancelable okay shove follow up. If Arjun's opponent fears being too close to Arjun, throw out Crouching MP, a safe on block (if well spaced) sweep similar to Dee Jay's Crouching MK that knocks down on hit & punishes back walkers who are too afraid of Arjun's specials. Once you've gotten in, use Standing LP, a plus on block jab that leaves Arjun in throw range where he can threaten with his various mix up options.

Arjun's most notable trait by far is his unique special attacks, as already explained, Arjun deals gray life on block with all of his specials. Arms of Justice is a tool Arjun can cancel into or throw out in neutral that's always safe, can be spaced to be plus on block, & takes a decent amount of gray life on block. If they take to the skies, Cruel Shoulder is a decent anti air that leaves opponents right next to you on hit & can be synergized remarkably well with his next special, Divine Pillar. Divine Pillar is a Seismic Hammer-like attack where Arjun blows into the ground & creates a rock spire which he can interact with using Cruel Shoulder which leads into some amazing damage on hit & gray damage on block. Once they've gotten wise to his specials not dealing gray damage on parry, throw in a Ghastly Interrogation, an unblockable command grab that deals gray damage without any gray health accumulated & is a way to cash out on the gray life already accumulated with his specials. Opponents who dare zone Arjun out will be forced to deal with Indomitable Defense, a very unique counter that only activates on strikes & stays active against projectiles (making him virtually invincible to every projectile in the game), once they throw a projectile, you can punish with Moral Breakdown, a special outside of Indomitable Defense that deals immense damage on hit & gray damage on block. If you hold the advantage from afar, utilize the Breathing Ring, a projectile in which you blow a ring in front of you with 3 different angles to throw it in.

Arjun, while being a great offensive character has very little defense in return. Arjun's normals aren't the best in class, they come out slow & his longer ranged buttons are not cancelable. Once he gets knocked down, he must rely on system mechanics alone due to not having an OD reversal & his special reversals aren't the fastest either. While he has good health, his walk speed makes neutral & chasing an opponent down difficult against defensive neutral styles. He lacks traditional buttons in favor of more unique buttons (no cancelable Crouching MP & no cancelable Crouching MK) which makes getting in difficult in neutral.

moves.name: Divine Pillar
moves.notes: Button strength determines pillar distance (LK close, MK middle, HK far); holding the button results in a delayed activation

moves.name: OD Divine Pillar
moves.notes: Button combination determines pillar distance (LK+MK close, LK+HK middle, MK+HK far); holding the buttons results in a delayed activation

moves.name: Justice Beyond
moves.notes: Occurs automatically when Cruel Shoulder connects with a placed Divine Pillar; will auto-correct if Arjun is behind the opponent when swinging the pillar; no difference between strengths of Cruel Shoulder or Divine Pillar (including OD versions)

moves.name: Indomitable Defense
moves.notes: Absorbs any strike or projectile attack (including Super Arts) without incurring any recoverable damage; automatically performs a counter-attack when absorbing a strike (but not a projectile); can walk forward or backward while holding button (walk speed: 0.02 in either direction); counter-attack will autocorrect to face the opponent if they switch sides

moves.name: Moral Breakdown
moves.notes: 11-hit projectile hitbox; can be used to safely pressure without the threat of Drive Impact or reversal SA1

moves.name: Howling Destruction
moves.notes: 12-hit Super-priority projectile hitbox; aims near the ground before sweeping outward and upward (less range on early active frames but reaches fullscreen on the final 2 hits); can hit cross-up (even on grounded opponents if they extend a forward hurtbox while behind Arjun); useful juggle ender; can be used as an anti-fireball tool at mid range (less like to punish if clashing with multiple projectile hits)

moves.name: Yaksha's Order
moves.notes: Cinematic time regenerates ~2.1 Drive bars for Arjun

moves.name: Yaksha's Order (CA)
moves.notes: Available at 25% HP or below; cinematic time regenerates ~2.3 Drive bars for Arjun

moves.name: Breathing Ring
moves.notes: No difference between button strengths; projectile dissipates on contact with opponent

moves.name: OD Breathing Ring
moves.notes: 2 hits; projectile moves forward slightly while active; can input follow-up even after projectile connects with opponent

moves.name: OD Breathing Shockwave
moves.notes: Button strength determines the projectile angle (LP straight, MP 45 degree angle, HP nearly vertical)

moves.name: Breathing Shockwave
moves.notes: Button strength determines the projectile angle (LP straight, MP 45 degree angle, HP nearly vertical); does not shoot a projectile if the initial Breathing Ring was dissipated on hit, block, or projectile clash

moves.name: Scale of the Judged
moves.notes: Side switch; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: Back Taunt
moves.notes: "Hmmm. This will not end well for you."; tosses a rock into the air, creating a large projectile hitbox when his breath collides with it; hitbox whiffs on crouching opponents unless they extend a vertical hurtbox; deals 200 recoverable damage on block

moves.name: Penitent Fist (Hold)
moves.notes: Allows the TC to combo after a 5HK Punish Counter launch (full charge) or a high anti-air connect (partial charge)

moves.name: Standing Heavy Punch
moves.notes: 1f less recovery on block

moves.name: Loose Cannon
moves.notes: Always a true blockstring; HP/HK follow-ups can only be input on hit

moves.name: Hot Pursuit
moves.notes: Chases the opponent down for strong midscreen oki; cannot be input on block

moves.name: Suppression
moves.notes: () refers to scaled damage from 5HP~HP combo starter; cannot be input on block; only combos in the corner (opponent is too far to connect midscreen)

moves.name: Standing Medium Kick
moves.notes: 2f less recovery on block

moves.name: Impose Order
moves.notes: 3f gap between hits on block; knocks down on counter-hit/Punish Counter (canceling into Super does not combo off the knockdown)

moves.name: Neutral Taunt
moves.notes: "You challenge me? You stand no chance. Ahh... haha. Your move. Your lack of rhythm disturbs me."; can change which dance Arjun performs by holding a direction (forward/back/up/down) and extend the taunt indefinitely

moves.name: HP Cruel Shoulder
moves.notes: Reaches fullscreen; launches opponent upward followed by a limited juggle OTG bounce state

moves.name: Ghastly Interrogation
moves.notes: Deals recoverable damage to the opponent (cannot K.O. a low-health opponent); if the opponent already accumulated any recoverable damage, it instead deals actual damage and can K.O. the opponent

moves.name: OD Ghastly Interrogation
moves.notes: Deals recoverable damage to the opponent (cannot K.O. a low-health opponent); if the opponent already accumulated any recoverable damage, it instead deals actual damage and can K.O. the opponent; takes a step forward on startup similar to 236PP

moves.name: Shield of the Vindicator (Block)
moves.notes: Performed by inputting 6HPHK during blockstun; 5f extra recovery on hit; freezes the screen for 4f during startup; see Drive Reversal.

moves.name: Shield of the Vindicator (Recovery)
moves.notes: Performed by holding 6HPHK on wakeup; 5f extra recovery on hit; does not have any screen freeze except for a 12f freeze when interacting with the opponent's throw hitbox (this also refunds 1 Drive bar after punishing the throw); see Drive Reversal.

moves.name: Forward Taunt
moves.notes: "One moment. There. Many thanks."

moves.name: Excessive Force
moves.notes: See Drive Impact. Airborne connect gives spinning juggle state on Punish Counter or corner Wall Splat with variable height.

moves.name: Jumping Heavy Kick
moves.notes: Reaches farther downward than Arjun's other air normals (more likely to punish whiffed normals / projectiles / throw techs and harder to anti-air on reaction); knocks down the opponent on any hit (no follow-up combo is possible making it less rewarding than most air normals); lower body projectile invuln 10-21f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Jumping Heavy Punch
moves.notes: Cross-up (can connect even from a point blank forward jump); spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents; 1st active frame can only hit forward while the final active frame can only hit cross-up (2 separate hitboxes overlap during the middle 4 active frames); extends a large downward hurtbox that makes it vulnerable to otherwise weak anti-airs (like many 5LP/2LP/2MP attacks); lower body projectile invuln 10-22f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Jumping Light Kick
moves.notes: Strong downward hitbox priority

moves.name: Jumping Light Punch
moves.notes: Fast air-to-air with strong horizontal hitbox priority

moves.name: Jumping Medium Kick
moves.notes: Greatest horizontal range of Arjun's air normals; lower body projectile invuln 9-26f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Jumping Medium Punch
moves.notes: Puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; lower body projectile invuln 8-22f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Righteous Verdict
moves.notes: ; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: Drive Parry
moves.notes: See Drive Parry. Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

moves.name: Drive Rush Cancel
moves.notes: See Drive Rush; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

moves.name: Parry Drive Rush
moves.notes: See Drive Rush; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: ? (min/throw), ? (min/block), ? (max/final DR frame)
